definition: v2: fixed five-second server windows, independent account probe on separate browser site, unchanged numeric limits

measuredTier.audio: all talk, synthetic broadband Opus, 64 kbps target

limitations: Disposable backend runs on the production host with a separate worker, database and Redis, the deployed image and a 2 GiB limit. Ancillary production account services are not all represented.
Signaling uses the temporary operator-only HTTPS/WSS route; media travels directly over the network.
Synthetic audio proves transport and decoding, not physical speaker output or real mobile behavior.
Eight guests is the measured tier, not the hardware breaking point.
Normal account world voice is exercised; direct-call UI signaling is a separate journey check.
Account and guest pages use distinct browser sites but share one physical computer and network.
metadataCorrection: Corrected two stale limitation strings after the run began. The recorded numeric criteria, duration and participant counts are unchanged.
